title: Amazon EBS Provisioned IOPS SSD volumes (io2 Block Express and io1)
note: Lesson 3.1, K03: confirms io2 Block Express delivers up to 256,000 IOPS and 4,000 MiB/s on Nitro-based instances with sub-millisecond average latency and 99.999% durability, and that io1 is a distinct, still-current Provisioned IOPS SSD type (up to 64,000 IOPS, 1,000 MiB/s, 4 GiB–16 TiB, all instance types).
